gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-piazzolla: Pramukh Rounded crowds its friendly letters close together, bowls tipped open. Piazzolla, a classic serif with a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, gives the page a more authoritative voice beneath that soft, tightly packed heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters wide with room to spare. Noto Sans Meroitic follows in a plain sans whose small letters fill the line like capitals, so the page feels approachable under such a commanding heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-multani: Commanding, wide-set Goldman leads with round forms that curve like open parentheses. Noto Sans Multani brings a lofty x-height and an e with a wide terminal gap, and that lift is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Wide, bold and round-cornered up top. Noto Sans Syriac Western keeps its terminals far from the stroke body, so the small letters bundle tall like cable and Goldman's loud headline gives way to a clean, modern text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Big, wide and unmistakably loud. Noto Sans Tai Tham fills the text with chalk-board lowercase that crowds up toward the capital line, while its open c stays easy to see through beneath Goldman's generous spacing.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tc: Bold Goldman sets wide, round letters over a big lowercase. Noto Sans TC counters with large open shapes in its tall a, e and s, and that outward-opening generosity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kedebideri: Chunky, upbeat and held wide open. Kedebideri, a plain sans, rises to a skyward x-height with rounded letters, while Grandstander's constant-width lines have none of the swelling where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-matangi: Loud, bouncy letters with a tall x-height. Matangi has hefty lowercase strokes like twine pressed flat, so if Grandstander shrinks or the sans grows large, the two start crowding each other.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-headline: Plump, bold and happily uneven in attitude. Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal under Grandstander's constant pen-pressure look, so give the heading the larger size and let the sans stay modest.
